scientific_question: Do the v133 detector-spectral directions contain a full-gate candidate that was hidden by the equal-weight field/projection objective, when a finite preregistered projection-priority roster and a truth-aware Pareto selector are used only as an opened-fit capacity diagnostic?

prior_result.interpretation: All 1347 v133 cell failures were observation-only. This motivates an objective-weight diagnostic without changing representation, data, physics or online cost.

data_contract.factorized_conditions: The frozen v128 roster of 37 clean, observation-noise, pose, intrinsic and combined conditions.

representation_contract.basis: Exactly the v133 per-active-camera, per-displacement-component DCT-II LL/LH/HL/HH detector directions.
representation_contract.basis_count: 8 times the active camera count, hence 40/56/72/96 directions for 5/7/9/12 cameras.
representation_contract.input_proposal: The independently validated v131.1 held-out predicted correction dual, restricted to active cameras.
representation_contract.field_contributions: h_j=A_g^T d_j under the frozen reported geometry.
representation_contract.projected_contributions: p_j=A_g h_j under the same frozen reported geometry.
representation_contract.teacher_targets: h_star=A_g^T(z4-z1) and p_star=A_g h_star from the already opened fit-only K4 teacher.
representation_contract.weight_one_reproduction: The projection-weight-1 endpoint must reproduce v133 coefficients and metrics within 2e-12 or the whole run fails.

objective_roster.finite_weight_objective: Minimize unit-weight relative squared field-lift error plus projection_weight times relative squared projected-lift error.
objective_roster.projection_only_objective: Minimize relative squared projected-lift error with zero field-objective weight.
objective_roster.ridge_scale: Mean diagonal of each candidate's own unregularized weighted Gram matrix.
objective_roster.formal_solver: float64 direct solve of the regularized normal equations
objective_roster.independent_solver: float64 symmetric eigendecomposition of the same frozen equations
objective_roster.canonicalization: Normalize active coefficients to unit RMS and orient the common sign toward nonnegative projected-target inner product.
objective_roster.truth_boundary: Teacher targets and final metric ratios are opened-fit truth-aware quantities used only for representation/objective capacity.

selector.first_level: If any roster candidate has all four per-cell metric ratios at most 1.05, choose the candidate minimizing the maximum four-metric ratio, then observation ratio, then frozen roster order.
selector.second_level: Otherwise, among candidates whose field, full-gradient and interior-gradient ratios are all at most 1.05, choose minimum observation ratio, then minimum worst physical ratio, then roster order.
selector.fallback: If no candidate satisfies all three physical metrics, choose minimum worst physical ratio, then observation ratio, then roster order.
selector.deployment_boundary: The selector reads opened truth metrics and is not deployable. It only asks whether this finite objective roster contains a passing direction.

accuracy_gate.grouping: Each complete trajectory separately over all 740 cells.

call_accounting.candidate_online_shell: zero-start CGLS K1 plus one selected exact A_g^T lift and one exact A_g projection
call_accounting.offline_capacity_work: The seven truth-aware solves and algebraic candidate evaluations are diagnostic-only and excluded from deployable cost claims.
call_accounting.physical_replay: Only the selected direction is replayed through the exact online shell and must match the algebraic replay.

decision_rule.pass_action: Record objective-mismatch development headroom and authorize only a separately frozen minimal permutation-equivariant observation/geometry-only coefficient predictor.
decision_rule.fail_action: Close this finite projection-priority objective roster. Do not train a larger network; next inspect whether local space-frequency interaction directions are missing.
decision_rule.inference_limit: Failure does not prove that no coefficient in the full continuous v133 span can pass.

source_contract.truth_gauge: interior mean removed with a zero boundary support mask
